title: SourcesIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: sources.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Sources server/items.js indexEvent). An item of a source with search_visibility was created or updated; the payload is its search.index-document@1 (owner sources, type item, visibility members for role:admin and role:global_mod, authorship imported, indexability noindex third_party_content). Consumed by OpenVibe.Search (*.index_document.*). Envelope: subject { type: item, id: <item id>, revision }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:sources.
